item.text: The pager stops when a page contains fewer live records than requested, even when the gateway supplies a continuation cursor. Deleted records can make a page short or empty. Project exports use a larger page size, which masks this case. I’ll make the pager stop only when the cursor is `null`.

item.text:
Fixed CAT-284. Exports now follow continuation cursors until `null`, so deleted records no longer cause an early stop. Your example exports both `i-1` and `i-3`.

Added regression coverage for short pages, fully deleted pages, and empty cursor tokens. All 5 tests pass; `git diff --check` passes.
